set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP install cryptsetup =="
sudo -n dnf install -y cryptsetup >/tmp/dnf-install.log 2>&1 && tail -5 /tmp/dnf-install.log

echo "== STEP create key dir and image dir =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/secure-keys
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/secure-volume
sudo -n chmod 700 /etc/secure-keys

echo "== STEP generate keyfile =="
sudo -n sh -c 'dd if=/dev/urandom of=/etc/secure-keys/secure.key bs=512 count=4 2>/dev/null'
sudo -n chmod 400 /etc/secure-keys/secure.key
sudo -n chown root:root /etc/secure-keys/secure.key

echo "== STEP create backing image =="
sudo -n fallocate -l 2G /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
sudo -n chmod 600 /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img

echo "== STEP attach loop device =="
sudo -n losetup -f
LOOPDEV=$(sudo -n losetup -f)
echo "chosen loop device: $LOOPDEV"
sudo -n losetup "$LOOPDEV" /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
echo "$LOOPDEV" | sudo -n tee /tmp/loopdev.txt

echo "== STEP luksFormat =="
sudo -n cryptsetup luksFormat --batch-mode --key-file /etc/secure-keys/secure.key "$LOOPDEV"

echo "== STEP luksOpen =="
sudo -n cryptsetup luksOpen --key-file /etc/secure-keys/secure.key "$LOOPDEV" secure

echo "== STEP mkfs =="
sudo -n mkfs.xfs -f /dev/mapper/secure

echo "== STEP mkdir mountpoint =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/secure

echo "== STEP get LUKS UUID =="
LUKS_UUID=$(sudo -n cryptsetup luksUUID "$LOOPDEV")
echo "LUKS UUID: $LUKS_UUID"
echo "$LUKS_UUID" | sudo -n tee /tmp/luksuuid.txt

echo "== DONE PHASE1 =="

command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP write loop-attach service =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/secure-loop-setup.service >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop device for /srv/secure encrypted volume
DefaultDependencies=no
After=local-fs-pre.target systemd-udevd.service
Before=cryptsetup.target systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service
Requires=local-fs-pre.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/sbin/losetup /dev/loop0 /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
ExecStop=/sbin/losetup -d /dev/loop0

[Install]
WantedBy=cryptsetup.target
EOF

echo "== STEP write crypttab entry =="
grep -q '^secure ' /etc/crypttab 2>/dev/null && sudo -n sed -i '/^secure /d' /etc/crypttab || true
echo "secure /dev/loop0 /etc/secure-keys/secure.key luks,nofail,x-systemd.device-timeout=10" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/crypttab

echo "== STEP override systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service ordering =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service.d
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service.d/override.conf >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
After=secure-loop-setup.service
Requires=secure-loop-setup.service
EOF

echo "== STEP fstab entry =="
LUKS_UUID_LINE="/dev/mapper/secure /srv/secure xfs defaults,nofail,x-systemd.device-timeout=10 0 2"
grep -q '/srv/secure' /etc/fstab 2>/dev/null && sudo -n sed -i '\|/srv/secure|d' /etc/fstab || true
echo "$LUKS_UUID_LINE" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab

echo "== STEP enable services =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable secure-loop-setup.service

echo "== STEP current mount check =="
mount | grep secure || true
cat /etc/crypttab
echo "---fstab---"
cat /etc/fstab
echo "== DONE PHASE2 =="
